name: Example: Neon Fairway GUI
author: Golf Tycoon examples
description: A GUI theme mod (data only, no code): a synthwave night design for the whole interface - midnight-purple panes with sharp 6px corners and 2px cyan-glow borders, magenta primary buttons, electric-yellow focus rings. One JSON palette styles the HUD, menus, panels and popups; copy this folder to start your own design.
